# Edan Read - Portfolio

> A personal portfolio showcasing frontend development,
> professional experience and software projects.

## Main Pages
- [Homepage](https://portfolio-bxl.pages.dev/): Introduction and overview.
- [Experience](https://portfolio-bxl.pages.dev/#experience): Professional experience from 2019 to current.

- [Contact](https://portfolio-bxl.pages.dev/#contact): A contact form to get in touch with Edan.
